About the job
Ostrander Motion Systems is the German subsidiary of a US-based manufacturer of servo drives, linear axes and motion controllers. Our customers are machine builders in packaging, printing, woodworking and assembly automation. In the DACH region we generated revenues of EUR 140 million in 2025 with a sales organisation of 38 people: field sales, inside sales, application engineers and a network of eleven distribution partners.

Our Sales Director DACH has left the company. The search for a permanent successor has started, and we expect the new director to join in summer 2027. Until then we need an experienced interim leader who takes over the sales organisation and gets us back on track.

The challenge
Order intake is 12 % below last year. Several large machine builders have moved volume to competitors, and our field sales team spends too much time on small accounts. Salesforce was introduced two years ago but is used inconsistently, and our forecast accuracy is poor.

What you will do
- Lead the DACH sales organisation, including three regional sales managers, the inside sales team and the application engineering team
- Stabilise order intake and win back volume at the top 40 OEM accounts with a structured key account management approach
- Redesign sales territories and account coverage together with the regional managers
- Prepare and implement the price increase for 2027 and introduce clear discount governance
- Make Salesforce the single source of truth for pipeline and forecast, and establish a weekly forecast routine
- Review and strengthen the distribution partner programme
- Coach the management team and prepare a clean handover to the permanent director

What you bring
- 15+ years in B2B sales of capital goods or automation components, at least 8 years leading sales teams
- A track record of turning around sales organisations and growing key accounts with machine builders
- Experience with pricing projects and discount governance
- Practical experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud and pipeline management
- Fluent German and English
- Interim experience is a plus

Terms
- Interim assignment for 9 months, starting 1 November 2026 or earlier
- Four days per week: two days in our Stuttgart office, one to two days with customers, the rest remote
- Day rate between EUR 1,150 and EUR 1,300, plus travel expenses
- Freelance service agreement with Ostrander Motion Systems GmbH
